events.name: form_start
events.firesWhen: A visitor first focuses an eligible appointment form during a page view.
events.businessInterpretation: Interest in beginning an appointment request.

events.name: form_submit
events.firesWhen: The approved appointment endpoint confirms technical delivery.
events.businessInterpretation: Technical form submission succeeded; this is not automatically a lead.

events.name: generate_lead
events.firesWhen: The Worker validates the appointment request and the approved Resend handoff accepts it for delivery to the dental office.
events.businessInterpretation: Valid lead/request received; not a booked or confirmed appointment.

events.name: phone_click
events.firesWhen: A visitor activates an annotated telephone link.
events.businessInterpretation: Phone contact intent; not automatically a lead.

events.name: email_click
events.firesWhen: A visitor activates an annotated mailto link.
events.businessInterpretation: Email contact intent; not automatically a lead.

events.name: appointment_request
events.firesWhen: The approved appointment endpoint confirms technical delivery.

events.name: cta_click
events.firesWhen: A visitor activates an annotated approved call to action.

events.name: file_download
events.firesWhen: A visitor activates an approved pre/post-care PDF download link.
events.businessInterpretation: Care-information engagement; the file name and treatment are not sent.

events.name: form_step
events.firesWhen: A visitor changes step in the eligible multi-step appointment request flow.
events.businessInterpretation: Progress through the request flow; only the numeric step is sent.
